$comment: The series manifest — single source for the index page, the checks, the OG cards and the video pipeline. `migrated:false` decks still live as static HTML at the repo root. Articles live in essays/.

decks.title: The Next Token
decks.summary: Two camps argued about the answer. Nobody asked what the machine was looking at.

decks.title: The Tool Call Is Not the Plan
decks.summary: A reliable agent separates capability routing, exact tool planning, and guarded execution.

decks.title: Confirmation Is a Protocol
decks.summary: A boolean cannot hold a state machine.

decks.title: What Your Eval Is Actually Measuring
decks.summary: An assertion can be deterministic and still measure the wrong behaviour.

decks.title: Models Fail Differently
decks.summary: There is no single best tool-calling model — only models that fail in different ways.

decks.title: The Personal Agent Is a Typed Capability System
decks.summary: The durable advantage is the contract, not the prompt.

decks.title: Train Your Own
decks.summary: Five small machines, built from zero — and one idea underneath them all.
